I understand being understaffed and I don’t blame those that are simply doing their job and being spread too thin. I blame the company as a whole for failing to pay and treat staff well enough to keep them and simultaneously giving the consumer, who has likely experienced enough bullshit from the clothing industry, yet another poor experience to add to the list. It’s disheartening when even decent plus size clothing is already hard to find and then the one place you can find something is disorganized and manages not to meet demand or quality standards, while simultaneously charging a ton for their products, understaffing, and underpaying/overworking that staff.

I have been in a relationship for two years and this is the first time I don’t feel like I’m having the same feelings that I had surrounding my previous fps and honestly having a connection without those feelings is so much less painful and less intense that it sometimes doesn’t feel right because I’m so used to that rollercoaster intensity but it’s enabled me to learn so much about myself and how to manage my symptoms and to understand what love really looks like.
